register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: It takes a minute. You can finish your profile afterwards.
register.usernameHelp: 3–20 characters: English letters, numbers and _ , starting with a letter
register.passwordRules: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers

landing.headline: Write, share and learn with developers who speak your language.
landing.lead: ArabDev is where developers publish technical posts, follow each other's work and discuss code — in Arabic and English.
landing.featureConnectBody: Follow people working on the same stack and see what they ship.
landing.featureShareBody: Write posts with code, tables and links. Drafts save your half-finished ideas.
landing.featureDiscoverBody: Find open-source work and tools through tags and trending discussions.
landing.featureLearnBody: Ask, answer and review in comments, without the noise.

onboarding.title: Set up your profile
onboarding.photoBody: A clear photo helps people recognize you in discussions.
onboarding.profileBody: Your username is how people mention you. Your display name can be anything.
onboarding.interestsBody: Pick a few topics. We use them to suggest posts and people.
onboarding.interestsHint: Pick at least 3 for better suggestions
onboarding.peopleTitle: Developers you might want to follow
onboarding.peopleBody: Based on your interests. You can always find more in Explore.
onboarding.peopleEmpty: No suggestions yet — you're early! Explore the community once you're in.

feed.title: Home
feed.emptyBody: Be the first to share something: a tip, a question or a project you're building.
feed.emptyFollowingBody: Follow developers to see their posts and reposts here.

post.deleteConfirmBody: This removes the post, its comments and its likes. It can't be undone.
post.notFound: This post doesn't exist or was deleted.
post.signInToInteract: Sign in to like, save and comment.

editor.bodyPlaceholder: Write your post… Use the toolbar for headings, code, tables and more.
editor.tagsHelp: Up to 5 tags. Press Enter to add.
editor.imageHelp: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB
editor.attachLinkHelp: Shown below the post, e.g. a repository or article
editor.previewEmpty: Your post preview appears here as you type.
editor.leaveBody: This post hasn't been saved. If you leave now, your changes will be lost. Save it as a draft to keep it.

comments.title: Discussion
comments.emptyBody: Start the discussion — ask a question or share what you think.
comments.signInPrompt: Sign in to join the discussion.

profile.privateLists: This account keeps its connections private.
profile.emptyPostsBodyMe: Your posts and reposts will appear here.
profile.emptyRepliesBody: Comments written by this account appear here.
profile.emptyFollowersBodyMe: Share a post or two — people follow developers whose work they find useful.
profile.emptyFollowingBodyMe: Follow developers to fill your feed with their posts.

editProfile.title: Edit profile
editProfile.photoHelp: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, at least 96×96, up to 5 MB
editProfile.bioPlaceholder: What do you build? What are you learning?

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyDesc: Who can find you and mention you
settings.usernameHelp: Changing your username changes your profile link.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
settings.dangerBody: Permanently delete your account, posts, comments and uploads. This can't be undone.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: Enter your password to confirm. Everything you've published will be removed.
settings.languageHelp: The layout direction follows the language: right-to-left for Arabic, left-to-right for English.
settings.discoverable: Show me in search and suggestions
settings.discoverableHelp: When off, people can still open your profile from a direct link or your posts.
settings.showFollowLists: Show my followers and following lists
settings.showFollowListsHelp: When off, only you can see who you follow and who follows you.
settings.mentionsFrom: Who can notify you with a mention
settings.notificationsHelp: Turning a type off stops new notifications of that kind. Existing ones stay.
settings.privacyPolicyBody: ArabDev never sells your information and never uses it to target ads. The policy explains exactly what we collect, why, and how long we keep it.

explore.title: Explore
explore.noTags: Tags will appear here as people start posting.

search.label: Search
search.title: Search
search.noResultsBody: Try a different spelling, a shorter phrase, or search for a tag like #python.
search.startBody: Find posts, developers and tags. Use @ for people and # for tags.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: When people follow you, like, repost or comment on your posts, you'll see it here.

bookmarks.title: Saved posts
bookmarks.emptyBody: Tap the bookmark icon on any post to keep it for later. Only you can see this list.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.emptyBody: Drafts you save while writing appear here, ready to finish later.

ads.label: Sponsored
ads.whyAd: Ads help keep ArabDev free. They are always labelled.
